AI Suggestion.summary: A value the AI proposes for a form field, with the reason, Accept and Dismiss.
use: Form fields AI can fill from existing data (category, tags, owner)
Several suggestions on one form, with "Accept all" at the top
Imported or scanned documents, to propose values for review
avoid: Values only the person knows: use a plain Input
A summary of a record: use AI Summary
anatomy: Dashed tinted box with the Value
Reason ("Based on 12 earlier invoices from this vendor.")
rules: Nothing is saved until the person accepts
Accepted values keep an "AI generated" label until edited, with Undo
Low confidence says so in the Reason
Several suggestions: "Accept all" at the top, still one by one below
Store who accepted the value and when
a11y: Accept and Dismiss name the field ("Accept Expense category")
After Accept or Dismiss, focus moves to the field
The dashed border is not the only signal: the AI Notice says it in text
AI Suggestion.code: Custom on Card, Input, Badge. Store who accepted an AI value and when.

AI Summary.summary: An AI summary on a record or report page: what matters now, with sources, feedback and a disclaimer.
use: Record pages (customer, project, invoice) and report pages
Long histories people need in a few lines
Report pages, to state what changed in the period in numbers
avoid: Open questions about the record: use the assistant panel
A proposed value for a field: use AI Suggestion
One number people check: use Stat Card
anatomy: Meta: sources and age ("4 sources · generated 2 min ago")
Feedback and regenerate Button Icons (Show feedback)
rules: 2-4 sentences with numbers and dates, from named sources
Opening the sources shows exactly what was used
State=generating shows what it reads; State=error says what failed and offers Try again
Regenerate keeps the previous version until the new one is ready
The disclaimer uses the same words everywhere
a11y: Generating and ready are announced politely
Feedback and regenerate have labels and tooltips
Disclaimer text in foreground/muted still meets 4.5:1

Accordion.summary: A stack of Accordion Items that show and hide sections of content under a title row.
use: FAQ and optional detail (Density default)
Filter groups in a side panel, Sheet or Drawer (Density compact)
Settings groups in a side panel
avoid: Information every user needs to finish the task: show it on the page
Switching between panels of the same level: use Tabs
Steps in a fixed order: use Stepper
anatomy: Trigger row: Leading icon (optional), Title, Meta slot (Show meta), chevron
rules: The whole trigger row toggles
Several items may be open at once unless the content is mutually exclusive
Filters: Title is the dimension; Meta is a Badge Count of active values or a short summary
Show leading icon on all items or none
Groups with active filters are open by default
a11y: Enter or Space toggles; arrow keys move between items
The trigger is a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls
Keyboard focus shows the border/ring focus ring on the trigger row
Accordion.code: shadcn Accordion (type="multiple" when several items can be open).

Agent Plan.summary: A multi-step task the assistant runs, with status, Stop, progress and its Plan Steps.
use: Tasks with more than 2 steps
Long tasks that run in the background
Agent work that produces Artifact Cards (report, chart, table)
avoid: A single action: use Tool Call
The model's thinking: use Reasoning
Progress of an upload or import: use Progress
anatomy: Status: step N of M and time left
Steps slot: Plan Steps (pending, running, done, error) with Title, Detail and Time
Footer: what it will not do without approval (Show footer)
rules: Steps say what they do in the user's words ("Check payment history"), not tool names
Steps that send, pay or delete become a Tool Call with Status=approval
A failed step says what failed and what happens next; the plan never stops silently
Background tasks say so and notify when done
After it finishes, keep the plan in the conversation, collapsed to its result
a11y: Stop has a label and is always reachable by keyboard
Step changes are announced politely, once per step
Step status is in icon and text, never color alone
Progress has role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow
Agent Plan.code: AI Elements (model select, task, artifact) or custom on DropdownMenu, Badge, Card. Plan steps come from the agent's tool events.

Alert.summary: A persistent message about a page or section: a problem to fix or a state to know about.
use: States such as trial ends in 3 days, read-only access, sync failed
Layout=inline: a card above the content it concerns
Layout=banner: full width at the top of a page or panel (maintenance, read-only mode)
Notes and warnings inside documentation content
avoid: Confirming an action that just happened: use Toast
A decision before continuing: use Alert Dialog
An error in one field: show it under the field
anatomy: Icon by Variant: info, circle-check, triangle-alert, circle-alert
Title: the situation in a few words
Description: what to do about it (Show description)
Actions slot: up to three small buttons or links (Show actions)
rules: Variant matches the meaning: default, info, success, warning, destructive; always with an icon
Variant=warning is filled (background/warning) because amber fails contrast as text on white
The action that resolves the situation comes first
Dismiss only when no action is needed; remember the dismissal
Never stack more than one alert in the same place; show the most important one
Say what happened, then what to do; no blame, no "Oops"
a11y: An alert that appears after load uses role="alert" (destructive) or role="status"
Meaning is in icon and text, never color alone
Dismiss x has an accessible label and is reachable by keyboard

Alert Dialog.summary: Blocking dialog for a decision the user must answer before continuing: delete, discard, sign out.
use: Type=confirm: a decision with consequences that can be undone or is not destructive
Type=destructive: irreversible loss, such as delete or revoke
Type=acknowledge: one button, the user only needs to know
Discard unsaved changes
avoid: Restorable actions: act at once and offer Undo in a toast
Information that does not block the next step: use a toast or inline Alert
A task with fields: use Dialog
anatomy: Header slot: Dialog Header with Close off, title as a question, description
Footer slot: Cancel outline left, action verb right (destructive variant when destructive)
rules: Title names the action and object: "Delete project?"
Body says what is lost and "This can't be undone." when true
Buttons are verbs ("Delete project"), never Yes / No
No close button and no close on outside click
High impact (account, project, bulk data): type the name to confirm
On failure the dialog stays open with the error
a11y: Focus starts on Cancel (or the only button); Esc closes as Cancel
role="alertdialog": title and description are announced on open
After the action, focus returns to a logical place in the list

Approval Step.summary: One approver in an approval chain: who, the rule that added them, status, time and comment.
use: Approval chains for purchases, expenses, discounts, access and content
The chain column of an approval request, one step per approver, in order
The approver inbox detail, to show who the request waits for
avoid: Field changes on a record: use Change Item in an audit log
Steps the user goes through in a form: use Stepper
Events over time without decisions: use Timeline Item
anatomy: Marker by Status (check, clock, x) and Connector to the next step
Role and rule ("Finance manager · approves over €10,000")
rules: The whole chain is visible before anyone acts
Status=current: show the due date; the approver sees "Waiting for you"
Status=rejected always has a reason; Approve takes an optional comment
Last step: Connector off
Changing the request resets the steps that depend on what changed, and says so
Every decision is an audit log entry
a11y: The chain is an ordered list; each step reads name, role, status and time
Status is in the Badge text, not the marker color alone
Marker icons are decorative when the Badge says the status

Artifact Card.summary: Something the assistant made (document, chart, table), shown in the conversation as a card that opens it.
use: Reports, charts, tables and drafts an agent produces
Results people will edit, export or save
Every new version of a result the assistant regenerated
avoid: Short answers: write them in the Assistant Message
Files the user attached: use Attachment
Sources used for an answer: use Sources
anatomy: Icon by Type: file-text, chart-column, columns-3
Title: Document title, Chart title or Table title
rules: Open shows it in a side canvas or its page, where people edit, export or save
Meta names type, size and version ("Document · 3 pages · v2")
Each regeneration makes a new version; never overwrite silently
Each Type has its own title and meta properties
a11y: Open has a name with the title ("Open Q3 overdue invoices report")
The type is in the Meta text, not only in the icon
Keyboard focus shows the border/ring focus ring
Artifact Card.code: AI Elements (model select, task, artifact) or custom on DropdownMenu, Badge, Card.

Assistant Message.summary: A reply from the assistant: full width, no bubble, a small avatar, and the answer and its parts in the Content slot.
use: Every answer in a chat page or assistant panel
Answers that include Reasoning, Tool Calls, lists, tables, Code Blocks and Sources
Streaming replies (State=streaming) and failed replies (State=error)
avoid: Messages the user sent: use User Message
A one-off AI result on a record page: use AI Summary
Messages between people: use Chat Message
anatomy: Avatar with the sparkles icon, marks the speaker
Content slot: Reasoning, Tool Calls, text, lists, tables, Code Blocks, in the order they happened
Sources, with Citations in the text
Actions: copy, regenerate, good, bad (Show actions)
Alert with the reason and Retry (State=error)
rules: Lead with the answer, then the detail; short paragraphs in body/default (panel: body/small)
State=streaming: text grows with a caret, no actions, Prompt Input shows Stop
State=error: keep the partial answer, say what happened, offer Retry
Facts from data get a Citation; with no source, say "I could not find…" instead of guessing
Do not auto-scroll when the user scrolled up; show "Jump to latest"
Sanitize model output before rendering HTML
a11y: Streaming text is announced with aria-live="polite", once per finished paragraph, not per token
Action tooltips and labels: Copy, Regenerate, Good response, Bad response
Actions show on keyboard focus as well as hover
Reduced motion: no typing animation, show text in chunks
Assistant Message.code: Vercel AI SDK + AI Elements, or assistant-ui. Render with the product's markdown renderer.

Avatar.summary: A photo or initials that identify a person next to their name.
use: People in lists, tables, comments, headers and cards
Size sm in tables and dense lists, default in lists and sidebars, lg and xl on profiles
Owners and assignees on Entity Cards, Post Card authors, testimonial and team blocks
avoid: Several people in little space: use Avatar Group
State of a system or service: use Status Dot
Large team or product photos: use Image Placeholder with Show image
Companies and objects without a photo: use an icon or Shape=square initials
anatomy: Photo swap (Photo, Type=image): nested Image / Person / * instance clipped to the shape; default Image / Person / 01
Shape: circle for people, square (radius md, lg on lg and xl) for companies, workspaces and apps
Size: xs (20), sm (24), default (32), lg (40), xl (48)
rules: Always next to the person's name, or with the name as accessible label; never the only identifier
Type=image with a Photo when a photo exists; initials stay the default and the fallback
The Image / Person photos are sample faces (Unsplash License, not covered by the CC BY 4.0 license of the file): replace them with real photos
Pick a photo that fits the name, use a different person for each avatar in a block, and the same photo for the same person within it
Overflow avatars (+3) and organizations stay initials
Status dot only when presence matters to the task; same size within a list or group; one shape per list
a11y: Image alt is the name, or alt="" when the name is right next to it
The Status dot has a text equivalent ("Online")
Initials meet 4.5:1 on background/muted
Avatar.code: shadcn Avatar (AvatarImage with the photo URL, AvatarFallback for initials).

Avatar Group.summary: Stacked avatars for assignees, participants or the people something is shared with, with an optional label.
use: Assignees on a card or a table row
Participants of a project
"Shared with" in sharing dialogs
avoid: One person: use Avatar with the name
A list people read or act on: use a list in a Popover
anatomy: Avatars slot: 3-5 Avatars of one size, overlapping
Ring: 2 px background/default around each Avatar
+N for the rest, opens the full list
Label (Show label): body/small, muted ("Maintained by 3 analysts")
rules: Show 3-5 avatars, then "+N"
Same size inside a group: sm, default or lg
Full list in a Tooltip (names) or a Popover (names and actions)
Label says who they are or how many, not the names already shown
a11y: The group has a name with the count ("5 assignees")
+N is focusable and opens the full list
The Tooltip also shows on keyboard focus
Avatar Group.code: shadcn Avatar; group with negative margin + ring.

Avatar Upload.summary: Profile or logo picture in settings: the current avatar, the upload rules, Upload or Change and Remove.
use: Profile picture in account settings
Organization or project logo
Team, customer or workspace pictures edited by an admin
avoid: Several files or documents: use File Dropzone
Showing a person or organization without editing: use Avatar
anatomy: Hint: type, minimum size, maximum weight (empty and filled)
Upload or Change: Button outline sm, exposed (set its Label, e.g. "Upload photo")
Remove (Show remove): Button ghost sm, empty and filled
rules: State: empty, filled, uploading, error
Upload opens the file picker, then the Image Cropper
Show remove only when there is something to remove (a photo, or initials people may reset)
Errors say what to fix: "Choose an image under 5 MB"
Remove asks no confirmation and offers Undo in a toast
Hide the Label when the section title already names the picture
Hint wraps within 280 px
a11y: Buttons say what they do: "Upload photo", "Remove photo"
Upload progress and errors are announced
The avatar image has alt text with the name
Avatar Upload.code: shadcn Avatar + file input; react-easy-crop in a Dialog. Crop on the client, upload the result.

Badge.summary: A short label for the status of an object, a category or a count, as a solid or a soft (tinted) pill.
use: Status of an object (Paid, Overdue, Draft) next to its name
Category of an item
A count after a label (Count on: "Invoices 12")
Variant=soft-* for statuses repeated down a table or list (Paid, Pending, Overdue), so the page gets calm color
avoid: Filters and selections: use Chip
A number alone on an icon or sidebar item: use Badge Count
State of a system or person in text flow: use Status Dot
anatomy: Variant: solid default, secondary, destructive, outline, success, warning, info; soft soft-success, soft-warning, soft-destructive, soft-info, soft-neutral
Icon (Show icon, Icon swap) or Dot (Show dot), in the label color
rules: Text carries the meaning; color only reinforces it
One or two words, sentence case
Map each status to one Variant once and reuse it; a status never appears in two colors
Neutral: secondary, outline or soft-neutral; done: success; pending: warning; failed: destructive; new: info
One style per table or list: all solid or all soft
Soft colors come from badge/soft-*-bg (status color at opacity 10 in Light, 20 in Dark) and badge/soft-*-fg; never recolor by hand
Not clickable
Next to the primary information of a row, never instead of it
a11y: Label meets 4.5:1 on every Variant; warning uses dark text (solid) or amber/800 (soft)
Soft labels measured 5.5 to 11 : 1 in Light, Dark, Corporate Light and Corporate Dark
Never a color or dot alone
Not focusable: it is static text
Badge.code: shadcn Badge (+ success, warning, info variants; soft-* variants use bg-[var(--badge-soft-X-bg)] text-[var(--badge-soft-X-fg)]).

Badge Count.summary: A numeric counter for notifications, unread items or items in a navigation entry.
use: Corner of an icon button, such as the notifications bell
End of a sidebar item
Meta of an Accordion Item: active filters in that group
avoid: A count after a text label: use Badge with Count
A status word: use Badge
anatomy: Round container colored by Variant: default, secondary, destructive, outline
Position: icon button corner or the end of a sidebar item
rules: Above 99 show "99+"
Only for something the user must act on (unread, pending); never decorative
Numbers only; words belong in a Badge
a11y: The count is part of the accessible name ("Notifications, 3 unread")
Count changes that matter are announced politely
Text meets 4.5:1 on every Variant

Bar Chart.summary: Vertical bars to compare categories or periods, as one series, grouped series or stacked parts of a whole.
use: Compare values across categories or periods, such as revenue per month
Type=single: one series in chart/1, no legend
Type=grouped: up to 4 series side by side
Type=stacked: part of a whole per category, up to 4 segments
avoid: Trend over time: use Line Chart
Long category names or rankings: use Bar Chart Horizontal
One number people check: use Stat Card
Two measures with different units: Combo Chart when they explain each other, otherwise two charts
anatomy: Bars, max 24 wide, 4 px radius at the data end only
Chart Legend for 2 or more series (in Chart Card)
rules: One y axis, starting at 0 (two axes only in Combo Chart)
2 px surface gap between touching bars and stacked segments
Series colors chart/1..8 in order, also in stacked bars (series 1 at the base); color follows the entity, never its rank
Labels and values use text tokens, never the series color
Compact numbers (48.2K); edit bar heights for real data
Empty: say why ("No sales yet in this period"); loading: Skeleton in the chart shape
a11y: Every chart has a table view (toggle or "View data") for screen readers and exact values
Color never carries meaning alone: the legend and labels name each series
Per-bar tooltip on hover; hit targets bigger than the bars
Check contrast on background/card in light and dark mode
Bar Chart.code: shadcn Chart (Recharts) BarChart in ChartContainer; series colors via var(--chart-N) in chartConfig.

Bar Chart Horizontal.summary: Horizontal bars to rank and compare categories with long names, such as top customers, regions or reasons.
use: Rank items: top customers, regions, reasons for cancellation
Category names too long for a vertical axis
Compare parts of a whole with fewer than 6 parts, instead of Donut Chart or Treemap
avoid: More than ~10 rows: use a table of Table Cells
Trend over time: use Line Chart
Ordered steps with drop-off: use Funnel Chart
anatomy: Track with the bar; bar width is a share of the track
rules: Sorted by value, largest first
One color (chart/1); chart/2 only to highlight one bar that makes a point
Max ~10 rows; more goes to a table
Labels and values use text tokens, never the bar color
Compact numbers (48.2K)
a11y: Table view for screen readers and exact values
Values are written as text, so bar length is never the only carrier
A highlighted bar is also named in the title or insight, not only colored

Bottom Nav.summary: Bottom navigation for mobile apps with 3-5 top-level destinations used daily.
use: Mobile apps with 3-5 daily destinations
Field and customer apps used mostly on the phone
Customer apps: Home, Orders, Messages, Account
avoid: More than 5 destinations or rare ones: use the Mobile Header menu with a Sheet
Detail pages and flows: hide it; use back in Mobile Header
anatomy: Items slot of Bottom Nav Items
Bottom Nav Item: Icon (20) and Label
rules: 3-5 items; everything else under "More" or the menu
Bottom Nav Item State: default, active; active = foreground, others muted
Padding bottom = home-indicator safe area
Hide it on detail pages and while typing
a11y: Each item has a visible label, not only an icon
Active item has aria-current="page"
The whole cell is the touch target (min 48 x 48)
Bottom Nav.code: custom nav of links with env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

Breadcrumb.summary: Path from a meaningful root to the current page (shadcn Breadcrumb).
use: Record and nested pages in an app: Customers > Acme
Docs and help centers with sections
Settings sub-pages: Settings > Billing > Invoices
avoid: Flat apps with one level: no breadcrumb
Steps of a flow: use Stepper
anatomy: Breadcrumb Item ellipsis: collapsed middle levels
rules: Every item but the last is a link; current is not a link and has Separator off
Collapse the middle with an ellipsis item past 4 levels; it opens a menu
Never wrap
The last item matches the page title
Start at a meaningful root, not "Home" when the sidebar already does that
a11y: nav with aria-label="Breadcrumb"
Current item has aria-current="page"
Ellipsis is a labeled button: "Show path"

Button.summary: Triggers an action: a labeled button in six variants and three sizes.
use: The single main action of a view or dialog: Variant=default
Alternative actions: secondary; Cancel and back: outline
Toolbar and low-emphasis actions in dense UI: ghost
The confirming action of a destructive flow: destructive; text-like navigation in content: link
avoid: Icon-only actions: use Button Icon with a tooltip
Related actions of equal weight: use Button Group
One main action with variants: use Split Button
Choosing a value: use Toggle Group
anatomy: State=loading: a spinning loader replaces the leading icon; width stays
Variant=link: label, icons and hover underline use foreground/brand; no fill
rules: One Variant=default per view or dialog
Label is a verb; verb + object when ambiguous ("Save customer")
Dialogs and forms: secondary left, primary right
destructive only inside the confirmation step; the trigger in a list is ghost or a menu item
Loading (State=loading) keeps the width and the label ("Saving…" when it helps), shows the spinner and blocks repeat clicks
Disabled only when truly unavailable, with a reason nearby; never as form validation
Variant=link text and icons are foreground/brand (text-brand), never background/primary
a11y: Reachable with Tab; Enter and Space activate; State=focus shows the border/ring focus ring
Touch target at least 44 x 44 px on mobile
Loading is announced ("Saving…")
Text meets 4.5:1 in every Variant; link (foreground/brand) passes 4.5:1 on background/default, muted and card in every theme
Button.code: shadcn Button (variant, size); Leading icon is an icon child before the label. variant="link" uses text-brand (var(--brand)) instead of text-primary.

Button Group.summary: Related actions of equal weight joined in one control: Edit / Duplicate / Archive, previous / next, zoom.
use: 2-5 related actions of equal weight
Previous / next pairs
Zoom out / zoom in
avoid: Choosing a value or a view mode: use Toggle Group
One main action plus variants: use Split Button
Unrelated actions: use separate Buttons
anatomy: Items slot of Button Group Items
Position: first (left radius), middle, last (right radius)
Label and optional Icon on each item; icon-only with Show label off
rules: 2-5 items of equal weight
Positions follow the order: first, middle, last
Icon-only items always have a tooltip
Never use it to set a value
a11y: Wrap in role="group" with a label ("Invoice actions")
Each item is its own tab stop with a visible focus ring
Icon-only items have an aria-label matching the tooltip
Button Group.code: shadcn ButtonGroup, or custom flex of Buttons.

Button Icon.summary: An icon-only button, 36 x 36, for compact actions that a familiar icon explains.
use: Toolbars, row actions and card menus (ellipsis)
Message actions: Copy, Regenerate, Good response
Carousel arrows, Calendar previous and next
avoid: An action the icon does not explain: use Button with a Label
The main action of a view: use Button Variant=default with a Label
anatomy: Container in the chosen Variant: Size sm 32, default 36, lg 40
Tooltip with the same text as the accessible label
rules: Always a tooltip with the same text as the accessible label
Variant rules match Button: one default per view, destructive only in a confirmation
ghost in toolbars and dense UI
Copy turns the icon into a check for 2 s with the label "Copied"; no toast
Size matches the Buttons next to it: sm in tables and dense toolbars, lg next to lg Buttons in heroes
a11y: aria-label in code, same text as the tooltip
The tooltip shows on hover and on keyboard focus
Icon meets 3:1; touch target at least 44 x 44 px on mobile
Button Icon.code: shadcn Button size="icon" with aria-label, wrapped in Tooltip.

Calendar.summary: A month view for picking a day or a range; the base of Date Picker, Date Range Picker and booking.
use: Inside a Popover for Date Picker
Inline for bookings with availability, with time slots next to it
Two months side by side for ranges on desktop
A small month with event dots on mobile schedules
avoid: Far-away dates known by heart (birth date, document expiry): use a text Input with a date mask
Planning many events: use the scheduler month view
anatomy: Grid of Calendar Days: today, selected, range, outside, disabled
rules: Today is always marked (State=today)
Week start follows the locale: Monday in most of Europe
Unavailable dates are disabled with the reason nearby ("Closed on Sundays")
Days of adjacent months use State=outside (muted)
Ranges use range-start, range-middle and range-end
a11y: Arrows move by day, PageUp/PageDown by month, Enter selects, Esc closes
Each day has a full date label ("Thursday, 22 October 2026")
Today and selected are not color alone (aria-current, aria-selected)
The focused day shows the focus ring (State=focus)
Calendar.code: shadcn Calendar (react-day-picker) with weekStartsOn and the product locale.

Calendar Event.summary: An event in the day and week views of a scheduler: a card with a left bar in its calendar's color.
use: Meetings, shifts, bookings and rooms in day or week views
Month view cells: Size=compact, up to 3 per day
One Category per calendar or event type, with a legend
avoid: Items that move through stages without dates: use Kanban Card
Tasks with dependencies over weeks: use Gantt Bar
Picking a single date: use Calendar or Date Picker
anatomy: Left bar in the category color (Category 1-4 = chart/1 to chart/4)
rules: Height = duration; 30 min or less uses Size=compact
Category color = one calendar or type, with a legend; never the only signal
Overlapping events sit side by side
Month view: up to 3 per day, then "+N more" opens the day in a Popover
Click opens details in a Popover or Sheet; confirm moves that notify others
a11y: Each event is focusable and its name includes title, date and time
Moving and resizing also work without drag, from the event details
The calendar or type is written in the details, not only shown by color
Calendar Event.code: custom grid, or FullCalendar themed with tokens.

Card.summary: A surface that groups content about one object or topic, with Header, Content and Footer slots.
use: Content about one object or topic, set apart from the page
Variant=outline inside panels, dialogs and long lists of cards
Variant=muted for secondary or summary information and placeholders
Size=sm for grids of many cards, sidebars and dashboards
avoid: A status message: use Alert, or a Badge inside the card
A metric, selectable option or post: use Stat Card, Option Card or Post Card
Groups inside a card: use spacing or a Separator, never a nested card
anatomy: Header slot (Card Header): Icon (Show icon, Icon swap, 20 px), Title, Description, Action slot top right
rules: Never nest cards in cards
Elevation=true only for one card that must stand out or floats; never a whole grid
One variant per group of cards; equal height and structure per row
Whole card clickable only with one destination; otherwise the title is the link
Footer: one primary action at most, usually none in a grid
Padding comes from density/card-* tokens; change the tokens, never single instances
Turn off Show header or Show footer when unused; never detach
Card Header icon: on all cards of a row or none; it names the card type, never decorates
a11y: A clickable card is one link with a hover state and a focus ring
The Card Header Title is a heading at the right level for the page
Action slot Button Icons have labels and tooltips
The Card Header icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the Title carries the meaning
Card.code: shadcn Card + cva: variant (default, outline, muted), size (default, sm), elevated (shadow-md). CardHeader icon: optional Lucide icon (size-5) before CardTitle.

Carousel.summary: Horizontal row of slides users browse with arrows, dots or swipe: product images, testimonials, related items.
use: A row of cards or images users browse, such as related projects or testimonials
Type=multiple: the next slide shows partly, so users see there is more
Type=single: one slide at a time, 720 wide
Testimonials past six; fewer read better in a grid
avoid: Content everyone must see: most people never pass slide 1, use a grid or list
Images of one product, property or asset: use Carousel Gallery
Rotating homepage banner: use Carousel Hero, or one static hero
Full-screen image viewing: use Lightbox
anatomy: Viewport, clips slides outside it on purpose
Slides slot: Carousel Slide, Image Placeholder, Product Card or Card
Carousel Arrow previous and next: outline under the slides, overlay on images
Carousel Indicator: dots up to ~8 slides, counter ("2 / 8") for more
rules: No autoplay; if required, pause on hover and focus and show a Pause button
Arrows disabled at the first and last slide unless it loops; hidden when everything fits
Slides keep one size; images use one ratio (16:9, 4:3 or 1:1)
Active dot is wider, not only a different color
Never hide important content behind slide 2 or later
Fill the Slides slot in the instance; never detach
a11y: Arrows labelled "Previous slide" and "Next slide"; arrow keys move when the carousel has focus
Each slide is role="group" with aria-roledescription="slide" and a label "2 of 5"
Dots are buttons labelled "Go to slide 3"

Field.summary: Wrapper that gives a control a visible label, a hint and an error message.

Password Strength.summary: Strength meter under a new-password Field that says how strong the password is and what is missing.

Under the new-password Field Preset
Setting a password after accepting an invite

People Picker.summary: Choose one or more people (assignee, approvers, share with) by searching name, email or team.
use: Assignees, approvers and reviewers
Share and invite dialogs
Any field whose value is a person
avoid: Free text values: use Tag Input
Moving many members between two sets: use Transfer List

Open: Command Input for the search
Results slot: Person Option rows with checkbox, Avatar, Name and Detail

Arrows move through results, Space or Enter selects, Escape closes

Popover.summary: Floating panel anchored to a trigger, for rich content that is not a menu: quick edit, details, filters.

Details or a share link next to the element they belong to
Filter options with few choices, a date picker, a color picker

avoid: A label or one-line hint: use Tooltip

Never nest popovers
Fill the Content slot in the instance; never detach

Post Card.summary: A card for an article, news item, case study or changelog entry that links to the full post; compact for related links in an aside.

Category Badge (exposed), Date and reading time
Compact: optional 1:1 image (Show image, 64 px, 48 px in sm), Title on 2 lines (ui/label, ui/label-small in sm), meta in Date (type · date)
Size: default or sm (smaller gaps and titles) for every Layout
rules: The whole card is one link to the article
Excerpt is 3 lines max, then truncates
Date and reading time on one line ("12 Oct 2026 · 6 min read")

One Size per list or grid; sm for lists next to a featured story and for grids of 4

a11y: One link per card; the Title is the link text
The image has alt text, or alt="" when decorative
Focus ring around the whole card
Post Card.code: shadcn Card with image, Badge and Avatar, wrapped in one link; size (default, sm) via cva: gaps, title class, image basis-1/3 min-w-[120px] max-w-[240px] in horizontal sm.

Progress.summary: Determinate progress bar for work with a known share: uploads, imports, multi-step completion.
use: Uploads, imports and exports of known size
Completion of a profile or setup ("3 of 5")
Bulk actions that run longer than ~2 s
A value per row, inside Table Cell Progress
avoid: Unknown duration under ~3 s: use Spinner
Content loading: use Skeleton

Picking a value: use Slider

Tone: default, success, warning, error (indicator color)

Always show the number or the remaining count next to the bar; never only color
Value variants are 0, 25, 50, 75, 100; resize the indicator for other values

Tone shows the outcome, not the amount: success when complete, warning near a limit, error when failed; the text says it too

Announce completion when it matters

Progress Card.summary: A goal against its target: label, status, value and target, progress bar and footnote.

Progress of a running task: use Progress or Agent Plan

The bar Value matches the percent in the Footnote
Amounts follow the locale format
a11y: Progress has role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow and a label
Status is in text, never color alone
The Footnote meets 4.5:1

Profile or setup completion in a card
A quota next to its label
avoid: Unknown duration: use Spinner

Tab enters the group; arrow keys move and select

Rating input in a review or feedback form

Send Button and close Button Icon

Tree Item.code: custom tree (role="tree") with shadcn Checkbox and Badge.

Treemap.summary: Part of a whole with many parts or a hierarchy (revenue by product, spend by vendor); area equals value.
use: 6 or more parts of one whole
Hierarchies, such as product line and product
Spotting the biggest contributors at a glance
avoid: Fewer than 6 parts: use Bar Chart Horizontal
2-5 parts where the share is the point: use Donut Chart
Exact comparisons: use a table of Table Cells
anatomy: Tinted fill with a colored edge (chart/1..6)
Label and value inside when they fit
Chart Tooltip on hover for cells too small for a label
rules: Largest rectangle top-left
Label inside when it fits, otherwise on hover
Tinted fills with a colored edge keep text readable in every mode
Color follows the entity, never its rank
a11y: Table view with every part and its value
Text on tinted fills keeps 4.5:1
Small cells are covered by the tooltip and the table view
Treemap.code: Recharts Treemap with a custom cell renderer.

Typing Indicator.summary: Shows that the other person is typing in a chat, with dots that pulse in sequence.
use: Real-time chat while the other person types
At the bottom of the conversation, after the last message
Support conversations, so the customer knows a reply is coming
avoid: Comment threads: they are read later, no typing state
Loading content: use Skeleton or Spinner
AI assistant working: follow the AI chat pattern, with Stop always visible
rules: Hide after 5 s without input
Dots pulse with motion/ease/linear
One indicator per conversation, at the bottom
With reduced motion the dots do not animate
a11y: Dots are decorative (aria-hidden); a polite text status says who is typing
Do not announce it again on every pulse or keystroke

User Message.summary: A message the user sent, in a muted bubble on the right of the conversation.
use: Every message the person sends in an AI chat
Shown at once on send, before the assistant starts
Above the bubble, the files sent with it (Attachment)
avoid: Answers from the assistant: use Assistant Message
Chat between people: use Chat Message
Comments on a record: use Comment

Actions under the bubble: copy, edit and resend (Show actions)
rules: Text is shown as sent; never rewrite or trim it
Actions show on hover on desktop and always on touch
Edit and resend continues the conversation from that message
The user's message is never lost, even when the answer fails

Actions shown on hover also show on keyboard focus
Each message says who sent it to screen readers (visually hidden "You")

Video Player.summary: Inline video player for tutorials, product demos and lessons, with poster, controls and captions.
use: Tutorials and product demos inside a page or card
Lessons and long help videos, with a transcript
Feature demos on a marketing or help page

A short visual in a tour step: use the Coachmark Media slot

Controls: play / pause, volume, captions, settings, fullscreen
Subtitles above the controls on video/scrim (Show subtitles)

Never autoplay with sound; muted autoplay only for short loops, with a pause control
Controls show on hover or tap and hide after ~3 s of playback
Captions for every video with speech; transcript for tutorials and long videos
Errors keep the poster, with a message and Retry
Ratio 16:9 unless the content is vertical; radius/xl in cards and pages
video/* tokens: the player stays dark in Light and Dark mode
a11y: Space or K play / pause, arrows seek 5 s, M mute, F fullscreen, C captions
Controls stay visible while one of them has keyboard focus
Every control has an accessible label; a captions track for every language
Video Player.code: native video with custom controls, or Vidstack (HLS and captions).

Voice Recorder.summary: Replaces the Prompt Input while the user dictates; the transcript lands in the input for review.
use: Prompt Input with Show voice on, while recording and transcribing
Mobile and hands-busy input
Long requests that are easier to say than to type
avoid: Panel and inline AI: hide voice (Show voice off)
Products without speech-to-text: turn Show voice off
rules: Ask for microphone permission only on the first tap, with a reason
State=processing shows "Transcribing…"
The transcript lands in the Prompt Input for review; never send it unread
Cancel returns to the Prompt Input

Recording and its time are announced, not shown by the red dot alone
Focus returns to the Prompt Input with the transcript
Voice Recorder.code: MediaRecorder + speech-to-text API; custom UI. Ask for the microphone on first tap.

Side Panel.summary: Inline panel beside the page content for details, properties or a preview of the object being edited; collapses to a 48 px strip.
use: Summary of the object being edited next to the form (status, codes, preview)
Properties or settings of the selected item in an editor or builder
Context people check while they work: related records, activity, help
avoid: Editing an object from a list without leaving it: use Sheet
Primary content of the page: put it in Main
Navigation between pages: use Sidebar or Sidebar Double

Content slot: Description List Items, previews, short lists
Footer slot: one full-width action (Show footer)
Collapsed: expand Button Icon and the Title, vertical
rules: 320 wide expanded, 48 collapsed; the page grid column hugs it, so Main takes the space back
Title names what the panel shows ("Showcase info", "Properties"), not the action
Content reads top to bottom; no tabs inside a Side Panel
Collapsed state is remembered per user and page
Below 1024 px open it as a right Sheet instead
a11y: An aside landmark labeled by the Title
Collapse and expand buttons have accessible labels and aria-expanded
Focus stays where it was when the panel collapses
Side Panel.code: An <aside> in the page grid with a collapsible state (shadcn Collapsible); right Sheet below 1024 px.

Sidebar Double.summary: Two-level app navigation: an icon rail for sections and a panel listing the pages of the active section.
use: Admin panels and internal apps with several sections of 5+ pages each
Products where people switch sections often and need the section's pages in view
Content management: one rail item per content area, its types in the panel
avoid: One level of navigation or fewer than ~12 pages: use Sidebar
Switching views of one object: use Tabs
Mobile: open the panel as a left Sheet from the header
anatomy: Rail slot: Sidebar Item (collapsed), one per section
Panel header: Panel title and Panel actions slot
Panel slot: Sidebar Groups with the section's pages
rules: Rail 48 wide, panel 240; Mode=collapsed shows the rail only
One active rail item (the section) and one active panel item (the page)
Panel title repeats the rail item's name
Panel actions only for the section (add a page or an item), one or two Button Icon
Rail icons have Tooltips with the section name
a11y: Two nav landmarks with labels ("Sections", the section name)
The active items have aria-current
Rail items are buttons with accessible labels; arrows move between them
The collapse trigger has an accessible label and aria-expanded
Sidebar Double.code: shadcn Sidebar with collapsible="icon" for the rail, plus a second Sidebar for the panel.

Meta Item.summary: One fact with an icon: date and time, place, people, length, size or contact.
use: Event, article and product facts in headers and cards
Contact lines in a Person Card
A row of 2-4 facts under a title
avoid: Label and value pairs in a details panel: use Description List Item
Status: use Badge
A number that matters on its own: use Figure
anatomy: Icon (Icon swap, Show icon), 16 px, muted
rules: The icon says the kind of fact (calendar, clock, map-pin, users, mail); never decoration
Same icon for the same kind of fact across the product
In a row gap 24, in a column gap 8; 4 items at most
Dates with time zone, places with the city
A link keeps the label color; underline on hover
a11y: The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the label carries the meaning
Text meets 4.5:1 on its background
A fact that is a link has a link role and a clear name
Meta Item.code: Custom inline element: icon (lucide) + text, flex gap-1.5, text-sm text-muted-foreground.

Figure.summary: A number with what it counts: stacked for headline figures, inline for counts in a header.
use: Headline figures in a report or study header
Key facts without a comparison period
Counts in a profile or topic header ("42 articles")
avoid: A metric compared to a period: use Stat Card
A goal against a target: use Progress Card
Label and value details: use Description List Item
anatomy: Value: heading/h3 (stacked) or h4 (inline); lg one step larger
rules: Layout=stacked for 2-4 headline figures; inline for counts in a line
The label reads on its own ("average time to get paid", not "time")
Add the source when the figure is a claim; one source line under a group is enough
Numbers in the locale format with units (€18,500, 47 days, 62%)
No trend arrows or colors here: that is Stat Card
a11y: Value and label are read together as one phrase
Do not round in a way that changes the meaning; the exact value in a tooltip when rounded
Figure.code: Custom: dl with dd (value) and dt (label), or a span pair inline.

Setting Row.summary: One setting: title, optional description and its control on the right.
use: Settings sections: notifications, preferences, integrations
On and off options that apply at once
A choice (Select) or an action (Change, Connect) for one setting
avoid: A form people fill and submit: use Field
Many options of one group: use a Checkbox group in a Field
A list of objects: use List Item or a table of Table Cells
anatomy: Control slot: Switch, Select or Button
rules: Title names the setting, description says what changes
Switches save at once, unless the section has its own Save button; then every row saves with it
Controls align right; Selects 200 wide
Disabled rows say why in the description
Group rows under a section title; 3-8 rows per section
a11y: The Switch is labeled by the Title and described by the Description
The whole row is not a click target; only the control
State changes are announced ("Payment reminders on")
Setting Row.code: Custom row with shadcn Switch, Select or Button; label and aria-describedby from the texts.

Person Card.summary: One person: author, expert, speaker, contact or team member, with role, expertise and contact.
use: Experts, authors and speakers on a content or product page
Contacts on a record or account page
Team directories and "Who to talk to" sections
avoid: A record with details and status: use Entity Card
A user picked in a form: use Person Option in People Picker
Avatar and name in a table: use Table Cell User
anatomy: Tags slot: expertise as Badges (Show tags)
Contact slot: Meta Items with mail, phone, link (Show contact)
Actions slot: View profile, Follow (Show actions)
rules: vertical in grids of 3-4, horizontal in asides and lists
Role says what they do here; Organization only when people come from several
Contact details people copy are plain text
Two tags at most; the rest on the profile
Photos square-cropped, same style across the grid
a11y: The name is the card heading at the page's level
Email and phone are links (mailto:, tel:)
A photo has the person's name as alt, or alt="" when the name is next to it
Person Card.code: shadcn Card with Avatar, Badge and links.

Event Card.summary: One event, webinar or session in a list or grid: date tile, format, title, time and place, one action.
use: Agenda and upcoming events lists (Layout=horizontal)
Event grids on a hub or topic page (Layout=vertical, with image)
Sessions of a conference day
Date position=image: grids where titles are long, so the title gets the full card width
avoid: The event page itself: use Block / Header Event
Calendar views with many events: use Calendar Event in Block / Scheduler Month
Articles and news: use Post Card
anatomy: Date position (vertical): text = Date Tile next to the title; image = Date Tile over the top-left corner of the image, inset spacing/3, on background/default
Tags slot: format Badges (Webinar, Online, In person)
Meta slot: Meta Items for time with time zone and place
Actions slot: one action (Register, Join waitlist, Watch recording)
rules: Sorted by date, soonest first; past events in their own list
Time always with time zone; place with city, or Online
One action per card; the whole card links to the event page
Past events: Recorded badge and Watch the recording, or no action
Full events say it in the action (Join waitlist), never by hiding the card
Date position=image only with Show image on; same Date position for every card of a grid
a11y: The Date Tile reads as a full date ("12 November 2026") for screen readers
One link for the card; the action is a separate button with a label that names the event
Badges are text, not color alone
Event Card.code: shadcn Card with a date tile, Badge and Button; <time datetime> for the date. Date position=image: the tile is absolute top-3 left-3 inside a relative image wrapper.

Resource Item.summary: A file or link people download or open: type icon, name, format and size, action.
use: Downloads on a product, dataset or report page
Attachments people take away: templates, guides, brand assets
Links to documents stored elsewhere
avoid: Files people upload: use File Item
Previewing a file: use File Preview
Navigation to pages: use List Item or links
anatomy: Icon tile (Icon swap): the file type
Name: what it is, not the file name
Meta: format · size · updated or pages
Actions slot: download, open or copy link
rules: Meta gives format and size before people click
A Download all button under the list when there are 3 or more, with the total size
Gated files say so in the meta ("Sign in to download")
Same icon per file type across the product
a11y: The action's label names the file ("Download Sample data, XLSX, 2.4 MB")
Opening in a new tab is announced
The icon tile is decorative
Resource Item.code: Custom row: icon, text, shadcn Button (ghost icon) with <a download>.

Quote.summary: A quotation in running content: default with a left rule inside an article, pull to break up a long page.
use: A sentence from a person quoted in an article or case study
One strong line between sections of a long page (Variant=pull)
An expert's view next to data
avoid: Customer proof on a marketing page: use Testimonial Card or Block / Testimonials
Notes and warnings: use Alert
Code or commands: use Code Block
anatomy: Rule on the left (default) or a quote mark (pull)
Attribution: Avatar (Show avatar), Name, Role (Show attribution)
rules: Word for word, with permission; no quotation marks in the text
One pull quote per page section, never two in a row
Attribution names the person and their role at the time
Under 40 words; longer passages stay in the body text
a11y: Code as blockquote with a figcaption for the attribution
The quote mark is decorative
Text contrast as body text, never muted
Quote.code: <figure><blockquote> with <figcaption>; Tailwind border-l-2 for the default variant.

Waterfall Chart.summary: How a starting total becomes an ending total through increases and decreases: cash bridge, budget to actual, revenue to profit.
use: Opening to closing cash or balance
Budget to actual, plan to forecast
Revenue to profit by cost line
avoid: Parts of one total without a start and end: use stacked Bar Chart or Donut Chart
Change over time: use Line Chart
More than 8 steps: group the small ones or use a table
anatomy: Y axis with currency ticks, gridlines, baseline
Total bars (start, end, subtotals) in color/neutral/400
Increase bars color/blue/600, decrease bars color/red/600
Signed value label on every bar
X axis step names, legend Increase / Decrease / Total
rules: Steps in the order they happen; start and end are totals
Every bar has its signed value (+€86K, −€64K); totals without a sign
Increase and decrease use the diverging arms, never series slots; say in the legend which is which
At most 8 steps; fold the small ones into "Other"
The footer says the result in a sentence ("€14K above opening")
a11y: Color is not the only cue: signs on the labels and the legend
The table view lists each step with its value and the running total
Red and blue keep 3:1 on card and page in every mode
Waterfall Chart.code: Recharts BarChart with a transparent offset bar stacked under each step, or ComposedChart with ReferenceLine connectors.

Combo Chart.summary: Bars and a line on one x axis for two measures in different units that explain each other, such as volume and rate.
use: Volume and a rate: invoices sent and the share paid on time
Revenue and margin by month
Orders and average order value
avoid: Two measures in the same unit: use grouped bars or two lines
Measures that do not explain each other: use two charts
More than one line or more than one bar series
anatomy: Left axis for the bars, right axis for the line, each with its unit on the ticks
Bars chart/1, line chart/2 (2 px, end dot)
End value label on the line
Legend naming the axis of each series
rules: Both axes start at 0 with round ticks
Pick the left maximum so the line stays clear of the bars
Legend says which axis each series reads on ("left axis", "right axis")
Label the end value of the line, not every point
The footer states the relation in a sentence
a11y: The table view has one column per measure with units
Series are told apart by form (bar, line) and the legend, not color alone
Axis text in foreground/muted, never the series color
Combo Chart.code: Recharts ComposedChart with Bar (yAxisId="left") and Line (yAxisId="right"), two YAxis.

Section Heading.summary: Title and description that open a section of an app or content page, with an optional overline and one row of actions on the right.

A content page section with a View all link
A group inside a card or a long form (Size=sm)
A search Input or a filter next to the title of a list

Actions slot (Show actions): Buttons, a search Input, a Toggle Group

Description says what the section holds in one sentence
At most two buttons in Actions; one primary
Show icon on all sections of a page or none; one icon per content type (reports, events, news)
Same Size for sections on the same level of a page

Actions come after the heading in tab order
A search Input in Actions has a label
The icon is decorative (aria-hidden); the title says what the section is

Feature Item.summary: One benefit, capability or step: icon tile or step number, short title, one or two lines of text, optional link.
use: Feature grids of 3 or 4 on marketing pages
Benefits on a careers page
What a plan or product does, in a two-column list (Layout=inline)
Under a centered Section Header (Layout=centered)
"How it works" sections with numbered steps (Marker=number)

Title in 2-5 words; description in one or two lines

Link only when there is a page that explains more

The title is a heading one level below the section title

; grid of 3 or 4 columns.

Action Bar.summary: The row of buttons that ends a form, a step or a hero: Actions slot, optional Leading slot and divider.
use: The end of a form or a settings section (Align=end)
The buttons of a hero or a page header (Align=start)
Under a centered hero, CTA or empty state (Align=center)
Back on the left and Next on the right in a wizard step (Show leading)
avoid: The footer of a Dialog: use the Dialog's own footer
Unsaved changes that follow the scroll: use Save Bar
Related actions joined in one control: use Button Group

Actions slot: secondary and primary Buttons
rules: One primary button per bar
end: secondary left of primary (Cancel, Save); start and center: primary first
Destructive actions go in Leading, away from the primary
Same button Size inside one bar
a11y: Tab order follows the visual order
The primary action is the submit button of the form
Disabled buttons explain why in a hint or a Tooltip

Summary Row.summary: One line of a money breakdown: label left, amount right; default, discount and total.
use: Order and cart summaries
Invoice and quote totals
Price calculators and plan cost
Tiers of a volume price
avoid: Record details that are not amounts: use Description List Item
Many rows compared side by side: use a table of Table Cells
A single key number: use Figure or Stat Card

rules: Same currency and number format in every row
Discounts carry a minus sign (−€62.50)
Total is the last row, with a Separator above
Labels say what is included (VAT 19%, included)
a11y: Code as a description list (dt, dd) or a table
The discount color is never the only cue: keep the minus sign
The total is announced with its label

Byline.summary: Who wrote, said or owns something: Avatar, name and one detail.
use: Author under an article title (Size=default)
Who said it, under a testimonial or quote (lg, or sm in a grid)
Owner of a record, a dataset or a report
Author in a list of posts
avoid: Several people: use Avatar Group with a label
A full profile with role, contact and actions: use Person Card
A comment with its text: use Comment
anatomy: Description (Show description): ui/caption, muted: role and company, or date and reading time
rules: One person per Byline
Detail is one line: role, company or date · reading time
Size follows the context: sm in dense grids, default under titles, lg under testimonials
The name links to the profile when there is one
a11y: The Avatar is decorative next to the name (alt="")
Dates in a <time> element
The link is on the name, not on the avatar alone

Pagination Compact.summary: Previous and next with "Page 2 of 12" for narrow places.
use: A list inside a card or a side panel
Tables in dashboards
Mobile
avoid: Large lists where people jump to a page: use Pagination
Tables with rows per page and totals: use Table Pagination
Feeds: use Load More or infinite scroll
rules: Disable previous on the first page and next on the last; never hide them
The label counts pages, or items ("21-40 of 248") when that helps more
Page lives in the URL when the list is a page of its own

Copy Field.summary: A read-only value people copy and paste elsewhere: API key, invite link, webhook URL, reference code.
use: API keys and tokens on an API Keys or integration page
Invite and share links
Webhook URLs, IDs and reference codes people paste into another tool
avoid: A value people edit: use Input
A short code inside text: use Kbd or inline code
A one-time code people type: use Input OTP
anatomy: Field: muted background, Value in mono, truncated
rules: State=copied lasts 2 s after the click, then returns to default; no toast
Long values truncate at the end; the full value is what gets copied
Secrets show only the last 4 characters until Reveal; show a full key once, at creation
The field has a visible label through Field that names the value ("Live secret key")
When copying fails, select the value and say "Press Ctrl+C to copy"
a11y: The value is a readonly input or text the keyboard can select
Copy has an aria-label that names the value ("Copy API key")
"Copied" is announced in a live region (role="status", aria-live="polite")
Copy Field.code: custom: shadcn InputGroup with a readOnly Input (font-mono) and a Copy Button; navigator.clipboard.writeText.

Search Field.summary: Search box for a list, a table or the whole app: search icon, a placeholder that names what is searched, a shortcut hint and clear.
use: Filtering one list or table as people type
The search of a Filter Bar or a Top Bar
Global search that opens Command Dialog on click or with the shortcut
avoid: Search with filters, sort and views: use Filter Bar
Picking one value from a list in a form: use Combobox
Free text that is not a query: use Input
anatomy: Clear (x), once there is a query
rules: State: default, focus, filled
The placeholder names what is searched: "Search invoices", never just "Search"
Results update as people type, with a debounce of about 300 ms; Esc clears
Clear shows only when there is a query; the shortcut hides while typing

No results: Empty State that names the query

Clear is a button with aria-label="Clear search"
The result count is announced in a live region as it changes

Inline Form.summary: One field and one button on a line: newsletter sign-up, coupon code, invite by email, add a tag.
use: Newsletter sign-up in a footer or a content page
Coupon or promo code in a cart
Invite one person by email
Adding one item to a list (tag, domain, email)

Searching a list: use Search Field
Editing a value that already exists: use Inline Edit

Hint (Show hint), Error or Success message under the row

On narrow screens the button stays on the line; below 320 px it goes full width under the input
a11y: The input has a visible label or an aria-label ("Email address")
It is a form: Enter submits
Error and success messages are linked with aria-describedby and announced in a live region

Currency Input.summary: An amount with its currency: a currency picker on the left and the amount right-aligned in the locale format.
use: Invoice lines, prices and budgets
Limits and thresholds (approval above EUR 5,000)
Forms where the currency can differ per record

Store the amount in minor units with the ISO code

Focus ring wraps the whole field

Phone Input.summary: Phone number with a country code picker; formats as people type and stores the number in E.164.
use: Contact details on a profile, a customer or an order
Two-factor setup and SMS notifications
Delivery contacts at checkout
avoid: Other numbers (IDs, quantities): use Input or Number Input
Common contact data in one go: use Field Preset
One-time codes sent by SMS: use Input OTP
